text: A blockchain based offering routed through a single broker produces a specific cluster of risks, including limited price discovery, no market making and therefore less liquidity, constrained short selling, impaired best execution, and no print to a tape or national exchange.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
abstract: Several additional risks are associated with the limited trading and associated limited material liquidity that results from a blockchain-based offering involving only one broker.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: offering structures with only one authorized broker-dealer
